response.original_title: They Need Love, They Get Angry, They Bleed
response.overview: An unabashedly critical investigation of the Belchertown State School for the Feeble-Minded in Massachusetts, prompted by a class-action lawsuit filed against the state when a patient died there.  This was aired in 1973 by WDIC-TV in Hartsford, Connecticut . The Deputy Mental Health Commissioner of Massachusetts at the time attempted to file an injunction to prevent WDIC from airing this film in Massachusetts.
